client_id.label: MyAnimeList Client ID
client_id.description: Your MyAnimeList API Client ID. Create an API application (type "web" or "other"), then copy its Client ID. Sent as the X-MAL-CLIENT-ID header.

use_ssl_verification.label: Verify SSL certificates
use_ssl_verification.description: Verify TLS certificates when calling the MyAnimeList API. Optional; default on. Disable only behind a self-hosted proxy with a self-signed certificate.
